==Skin Trivia == 
*The {{Color|Premium|Bosanka}} skin was a reference to a Bosnian soldier.
**The name is derived from the geographical region Bosanska Krajina, a region which was heavily involved in the Bosnian War.
*The original {{Color|Premium|Bosanka}} skin was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/49527545/profile ingvaras123].
*The version 2 of Level 0-2 {{Color|Christmas2019|Xmas}} skin had different reloading animation to all the other skins. Instead of kneeling down to pick up a rocket, it took out a present from its pocket and put it on the top of the present launcher.
*The {{Color|Toy|Toy}} skin was based on the [[wp:Army men|Army men plastic soldiers]].
*The {{Color|Premium|Fortress}} skin is a reference to the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Soldier Soldier] from ''Team Fortress 2''.
**The hat worn by the {{Color|Premium|Fortress}} skin on Levels 3 and 4 is based on the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Team_Captain Team Captain hat]. Only on level 3 it also has a small chance of being seen with flaming particles, which is a reference to the ''Burning Flames Team Captain'', a well-known unusual variant of the same hat.
**The design of the rocket launcher used by the {{Color|Premium|Fortress}} skin on Level 4 is based on the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Black_Box Black Box], a primary weapon for the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Soldier Soldier] class in ''Team Fortress 2''.
**The design of the radio backpack used by the {{Color|Premium|Fortress}} skin on Level 4 is based on the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Battalion%27s_Backup Battalion's Backup], a secondary weapon for the [https://wiki.teamfortress.com/wiki/Soldier Soldier] class in ''Team Fortress 2''.
*The {{Color|Lovestruck|Lovestriker}} skin is based on [https://lovebullet.wiki/wiki/Kanna Kanna] from ''Love Bullet''.
*In multiple images and the Level 2-4 icons, the '''Rocketeer''' still use the legacy face, however, in-game, the '''Rocketeer''' uses its new face.
* The '''Rocketeer''' currently has the second most versions for {{Color|Toy|Toy}} skin. This record is beaten by [[Soldier/Gallery|Soldier]] with {{Color|Premium|Doughboy}} skin.
*The {{Color|Pirate|Tiderunner}} skin was made by Nebula.<ref>https://x.com/itsjsnebula/status/2078148972116361498</ref>
**According to Nebula, the skin's name is Func.
*The {{Color|Beach}} skin was made by Nebula.<ref>https://x.com/itsjsnebula/status/2085760878356664360</ref>
*The {{Color|Beach}} skin uses a different face on the thumbnail and icon for [[v2.5.0]].
**This is because the skin originally had the same face as skins like {{Color|Deluxe|Maid}} [[Commander]],<ref>https://fxtwitter.com/itsjsnebula/status/2085760878356664360</ref>, but it ended up getting replaced by the {{Color|Beach}} [[Medic]]'s face.
